The "Extra Spicy" Version of the Extra Hot! Just like when hot sauces dress the bottles up in black/yellow/orange we wanted to heat to the aesthetic of our Extra Hot overdrive. Sonically these have been updated for a more versatile Size (Bass) control, but the rest of the pedal is the same as it was. These will drop in batches occasionally, and are exclusive to mythospedals.com From the Original Extra Hot The Extra Hot is the spiritual successor to the Hot Chicken * pedal we made a number of years ago with a handful of changes. The updated Extra Hot has two different circuits than the OG unit. The Left "Dine In" side features our take on the ever popular ODR sound. This side features Cut (Tone) and Size (Bass) controls that let you shape the voice to fit any setup. We have dabbled in the circuit in the past with the Erlking, but we wanted to reduce the high end and make it a bit more approachable. The "Take Out" side is an updated version of the drive from our Air Lane Drive/ 210 Double Drive pedals. The Flavor control allows you to adjust the Gain with the Sauce being a Volume control. The Take Out side is a simple single transistor, hard clipped overdrive that can be a boost, a low gain drive, to an almost fuzz like dirt pedal. Combining both sides yields a huge variety of sounds in a easy to use dual format. We found that all the bells and whistles one might expect from a two-in-one were NOT necessary in this box. This dual drive is made to plug in, crank, and play. Both sides work independently, but there is no order switcher on the Extra Hot. Approx. 10 mA Current Draw True Bypass Switching Mono In & Out Enclosure size: 4.705" L x 3.701" W x 1.657" H 9V DC Power (No internal battery clip) *Hot Chicken is now a TM of Seymour Dunca n.
